findings.summary: The four faculties lost the account of how they condition one another.

evidence.baseline: They stand in no hierarchy; they are heterarchical, in constant correspondence, each conditioning the others.
evidence.shipped: The four affect one another, and none should be mistaken for an unfiltered account of reality.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.5, abstract noun clusters, plausibly applied to heterarchical.
findings.diagnosis: Heterarchical names a real distinction, which is 4.5’s retention limb, and the distinction is the section’s only structural claim: these are not four stages. Affect one another is compatible with a hierarchy and therefore does not say it.

findings.summary: The definitions of the four windows lost their reasons.

evidence.baseline: Imagination is what lends sensation its meaning, the faculty by which we construct the world we believe ourselves to be sensing. Attention is the choosing by which some part of the whole becomes, for us, the world.
evidence.shipped: Imagination helps interpret it. Attention selects part of a larger field.

findings.diagnosis: The world we believe ourselves to be sensing and some part of the whole becomes, for us, the world are the same claim stated twice, and it is the claim the next section builds on: perception is construction. Interpret and select are neutral verbs that lose it.
